items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Struggles in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tommy DeVito: Forced into action in Munich
items.text:
DeVito completed 12 of 24 passes for 81 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich. He added 19 yards on four carries.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Questionable to return Sunday
items.text:
Kelce (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Falcons, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Goes to locker room Sunday
items.text:
Kelce went to the locker room during Sunday's game in Atlanta due to an apparent ankle injury, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: May return in Week 11
items.text:
